# Why each nf-core pipeline that fails in run_test_workflows.txt, and each WorkflowHub
# workflow that fails in run_workflowhub.txt, cannot run, and how Nextflow
# 26.04.6 fails on it, recorded by run_evidence.py. Each block gives the
# pipelines, then `=`, the kind (`invalid`, `missing` or `unsupported (decision N)`)
# and why in one plain sentence, then what Nextflow was asked (`$`, with `NXF_VER` for
# the earlier release that a pipeline names) and the lines of its output that show it
# (`>`). Each pipeline runs from its own folder, as after a clone. Tools that the
# pipelines call are stood in by a shell function that prints `1.0`.

alleleexpression
= invalid: the test profile gives no `--input` samplesheet, which the pipeline requires, so the test run fails; runs with their own inputs are not affected
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run alleleexpression -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] Input samplesheet not specified!

ampliseq
= invalid: an output of CUTADAPT reads `outformat`, which only its script sets, so a stub run fails; a real run is not affected
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run ampliseq -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ No such variable: outformat
>  -- Check script 'modules/nf-core/cutadapt/main.nf' at line: 14 or see '.nextflow.log' file for more details

bacmodel
= invalid: the stub of BACMODEL_SUMMARY makes an empty versions.yml, which processVersionsFromYAML reads as null, so a stub run fails; a real run is not affected
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run bacmodel -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ Cannot invoke method collectEntries() on null object
>  -- Check script 'subworkflows/nf-core/utils_nfcore_pipeline/main.nf' at line: 82 or see '.nextflow.log' file for more details

cageseq
= unsupported (decision 14): the pipeline is a DSL1 script, whose processes read `from` and write `into` channels, which iunctus leaves out and Nextflow 26.04.6 does not run either
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run cageseq -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ No signature of method: groovyx.gpars.dataflow.DataflowBroadcast.into() is applicable for argument types: (_nf_script_<hash>$_runScript_closure7) values: [_nf_script_<hash>$_runScript_closure7@<address>]

callingcards
workflowhub/970
= unsupported (decision 16): SEQKIT_SPLIT2 and DEMULTIPLEX have no stubs, so they need seqkit and callingcardstools to write the reads whose names the pipeline reads, and the simulator only makes up one file with another name (Nextflow fails in the same way with stand-ins that make the files of the simulator)
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run callingcards -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>  # with the stub `mkdir simulated; printf "" | gzip > simulated/simulated.gz; printf '"${task.process}": {stub: "1.0"}\n' > versions.yml` for SEQKIT_SPLIT2, with the stub `touch simulated.fq simulated.pickle; printf '"${task.process}": {stub: "1.0"}\n' > versions.yml` for DEMULTIPLEX
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ index is out of range 0..-1 (index = 0)

chipseq
= unsupported (decision 16): SAMPLESHEET_CHECK has no stub, so it needs its script to write the samplesheet that the pipeline reads, and the simulator only makes up an empty file
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run chipseq -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>  # with a `python3` that prints '1.0', with a `Rscript` that prints '1.0'
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ Error executing process > 'NFCORE_CHIPSEQ:CHIPSEQ:INPUT_CHECK:SAMPLESHEET_CHECK (samplesheet_test.csv)'
>   Missing output file(s) `*.csv` expected by process `NFCORE_CHIPSEQ:CHIPSEQ:INPUT_CHECK:SAMPLESHEET_CHECK (samplesheet_test.csv)` (note: input files are not included in the default matching set)

circrna
= invalid: the stub of MAJORITY_VOTE makes no `mirna.targets.tsv`, which the process declares, so a stub run fails; a real run is not affected (shown with a small script, as Nextflow first stops at SEQKIT_SPLIT, which has no stub and needs seqkit)
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run <reproduction of circrna>/main.nf -stub-run
>   Missing output file(s) `mirna.targets.tsv` expected by process `MAJORITY_VOTE`

$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run clipseq -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>  # with the Java libraries of nf-validation 1.1.3 in lib/
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ No signature of method: groovyx.gpars.dataflow.DataflowBroadcast.into() is applicable for argument types: (_nf_script_<hash>$_runScript_closure4) values: [_nf_script_<hash>$_runScript_closure4@<address>]

workflowhub/974
